Author: Gautam Chowdhary

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 79
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 56637 of 2022
Applicant :- Ved Pal @ Raju

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rahul Saxena
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.
The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-Ved Pal @ Raju in Case Crime No.379 of
2021, under Sections 420, 376, 342, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Jahanabad, District Pilibhit, with
prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

According to the prosecution version, the victim/first informant was studying in I.T.I. College,
Pilibhit and was residing at her aunt house, where the applicant used to come and she became acquainted with him.

The applicant called him for providing job due to which, she went to meet her J.M.B.Tiraha, where the applicant and one Ravi Verma came on a four wheeler and told her to put signature in a office, on account of which, she went away with them, who took her to Ganesh Guest House, Pilibhit, where the applicant on pistol point had committed rape, thereafter, she was threatened and was dropped.

sentences.text: It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in present case.

He further submits that the incident is alleged to have taken place on 14.10.2021, whereas the F.I.R. has been lodged on 30.10.2021 without any plausible explanation of delay of about more than 15 days.
He further victim is major aged about 22 years and that according to the medical examination, hymen was old torn and no injury was found on the person of the victim.
As per X-ray as well as supplementary report, there is no evidence of use of force.
It is thus submitted that medical evidence does not corroborate with the prosecution version.

Learned counsel next submits that in fact, the victim is a consenting party and that she has gone with the applicant out of her own free will and consent to the guest house without raising any alarm but she under the influence and pressure of her parents, she has falsely implicated the applicant in the instant case.
It is thus contended that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case therefore, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

It was further argued that the applicant is languishing in jail since 13.11.2021 having no criminal history and that in case, applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in the trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application.

Perusal of the record shows that the victim in her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. has made specific allegation against the applicant, thus keeping in view submissions of learned counsel for the parties, gravity of offence, nature of allegations, and all the attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, no case for bail has been made out.
Accordingly, the bail application of applicant-Ved Pal @ Raju, is rejected.
Order Date :- 20.1.2023 S.Ali  Ved Pal @ Raju vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190373444/
